pure-announcement.rationale: It is the standing README of the schema repository, documentation of an established standard rather than a launch, release, or funding announcement.

duplicate.rationale: The central idea — a minimal JSON vulnerability format that pins affected code to package versions or commit hashes, aggregated by osv.dev — is exactly what the existing concept 'OSV format' already states, including adoption breadth; this README adds only repo file pointers (schema.json, proto, tools/) and a longer adoption enumeration, so a reader of the existing concept learns nothing substantively new.

unfalsifiable.rationale: Claims are directly checkable against the linked rendered specification, JSON schema file, and the named public advisory databases.

durability.rationale: The durable mechanism (identify affected code by version or commit) occupies one sentence while the bulk is an adoption inventory and repo file paths that will drift within months.

actionability.rationale: Its concrete steps are repo navigation (run validate-schema-table.py, browse tools/ subfolders) rather than guidance that would change how someone designs vulnerability tooling beyond what the existing concept already gives.

atomicity.rationale: The note is about exactly one artifact, the OSV schema, and its core idea fits in a single paragraph independent of the README structure.
